name: Shri Techtex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Shri Techtex Ltd is in the business of manufacturing Technical Textiles, specifically non-woven fabrics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
STL is in the business of manufacturing of Polypropylene (PP) Non-Woven Fabric of different sizes, and density depending upon the client’s requirement. Company is also engaged in job work activities, providing customized solutions and services to its clients.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 26.3% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 20.5%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.22 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 92.7 to 111 days.
